description:
Per ADR-0001 (docs/adr/ADR-0001-ollama-client-not-port.md): KOPITIAM talks to a running 'ollama serve' over its REST API instead of porting the runtime in-process. The ollama-port branch is abandoned; its work is archived at archive/ollama-port (tip c0a819b).

WHAT TO BUILD
A client adapter in crates/kopitiam-ai/ sitting beside cloud.rs, implementing the same adapter trait the local/ and cloud/ paths already implement, so apps/cli and kopitiam-workflow need no call-site changes.

Endpoints actually needed (small, stable surface):
  POST /api/chat      -- the main path, streaming
  POST /api/generate  -- non-chat completion
  GET  /api/tags      -- which models are installed
  POST /api/show      -- model metadata (context length, family)

DESIGN NOTES
* Must degrade gracefully when ollama is NOT running -- that is the common case for a fresh clone, and per ADR-0001 the workspace must still build and every non-inference feature must still work. A connection refused is a clear 'ollama not running, start it with ollama serve', never a panic and never a hang.
* Bound every request with a deadline. NOTE the trap in bd-7b5/gh-77: kopi-beans' own watchdog is currently defeated by surviving grandchildren. Do not repeat that shape here -- this is HTTP, so use the client's own timeout, do not shell out.
* Sampling defaults: kopitiam-ai/src/local/generation.rs already transcribes ollama's DefaultOptions() with provenance. When talking to ollama directly, do NOT re-send those as overrides -- let the server apply its own, and only send what the caller explicitly set. Sending a stale copy of ollama's defaults back at ollama is how the two drift apart silently.
* Keep src/local/ working. ADR-0001 does not delete the in-process path, it just stops it being the thing we invest debugging effort in.

OPEN QUESTION worth settling early (ADR-0001 flags it as a thing that could make the decision wrong): does 'ollama serve' run acceptably on Android/Termux? If not, local inference is gone on the platform KOPITIAM most cares about being portable to. Worth testing before building much.
title: kopitiam-ai: add an ollama-server client adapter (ADR-0001), so local inference stops depending on the in-process runtime
